integrity: Universal bound and attainment proved analytically; finite checker is supplementary. No claim of physical deterministic implementation or independent validation. Source date is the first arXiv submission, not publication revision.
scientific_limitations: Optimizes only trace-normalized Kubo–Ando outputs of separable Bell-diagonal two-qubit states, not all separable or noncommuting inputs. Zero output cannot be normalized. Publication-priority risk remains, particularly alternate older formulations; no independent audit.
title: Sharp endpoint-mass law for Bell-diagonal entanglement under Kubo–Ando means
